title: 室内の小物
theme: decorative objects in calm Japanese and Western style rooms and a meeting room, realistic photographic materials, soft natural daylight, muted gentle colours, moderate contrast, not too dark and not oversaturated

cells.name: 楽焼の器
cells.prompt: glaze of a hand-made Japanese raku tea bowl in soft black and warm grey with a crackle pattern, about 0.3 m across

cells.name: アンティークの地球儀
cells.prompt: an antique world globe map surface in faded sepia and soft sea-green tones with continents and a fine grid, no text, no letters, filling the whole square

cells.name: 時計の文字盤
cells.prompt: a simple ivory wall clock face with thin black hour marks as small bars, two slim black hands and no numbers, no text, filling the whole square

cells.name: 油絵
cells.prompt: a calm oil painting of a misty lake with mountains and pine trees in soft muted colours, visible brush strokes, no frame, no signature, filling the whole square

cells.name: 盆栽の葉
cells.prompt: dense fine green juniper bonsai foliage pads, about 0.4 m across

cells.name: ピアノの鍵盤
cells.prompt: top view of a piano keyboard with ivory white keys and black keys in the correct pattern, filling the whole square

cells.name: ノートPCの画面
cells.prompt: a laptop screen showing a calm dashboard with soft blue line graphs and pale panels, no text, no numbers, no letters, filling the whole square

cells.name: 生け花
cells.prompt: a soft ikebana arrangement of white camellias, pale pink blossoms and green pine sprigs, filling the frame, about 0.5 m across

cells.name: 桐の箪笥
cells.prompt: pale paulownia (kiri) wood of a Japanese chest of drawers with straight soft grain running left to right and small iron handles, about 1 m across
